# Interface seed and closed visitor result

Unmodified Java8 compiler output retains one method-owned interface bound,
its direct seed and a complete contravariant-input/covariant-result callback.
The result is a public enum inside two static member scopes. An ordinary
Object overload challenges descriptor selection without predicting traversal.

Frozen observers check class initialization, original input and callback result
snapshots, nulls, opaque input implementations, bad raw callback results and
exact partial runtime/error failures. Source and declaration-only provider
profiles must compile every emitted Java unit and account for every original
class, method, Signature, field and Exceptions attribute.

A separately authored private provider forwards through its own public entry.
Its original body and declaration-site access remain mandatory; external or
foreign private calls receive no additional access from the shared type proof.
